catalysts.headline: Announced a Phase II expansion of the Pamesa Net Zero industrial program: additional orders worth ~EUR6.83M (~$7.6M), adding a net 51 MWh of battery storage across two new industrial sites plus existing locations; equipment deliveries set for H1 2027. Company also cites a $53M industrial backlog across 10 manufacturing sites (366 MWh total capacity).

Turbo Energy brought 62.5 MWh of intelligent battery energy storage online across three industrial sites (ECO Porcelánico, Compacglass, TAU Porcelánico) in the Pamesa Net Zero project; paired with 34 MWp of solar; company says it delivered 130+ MWh to the project in H1 2026

Turbo Energy brought 62.5 MWh of intelligent battery energy storage fully online (installed, commissioned and operating commercially) across three industrial sites in Spain — ECO Porcelánico, Compacglass and TAU Porcelánico — paired with 34 MWp of installed/operating photovoltaic capacity, all part of the company's $53M, 366 MWh Pamesa Net Zero contract (previously disclosed; this is the operational-milestone update, not a new contract)
